messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: Preflight blocked release v2026.06.12 -> prod: env parity check failed for `SERVICE_SECRETS` (format mismatch). See run: https://ci.internal/runs/11577

anika: Can you paste the failing diff from preflight?

ci-bot: preflight excerpt:
```
staging: SERVICE_SECRETS=--BEGIN-SOPS-ENC--
  payload: !!str |
    host: cache.stg
    port: 6379
    auth: token123
  meta: {rot: 3}
--END-SOPS-ENC--
prod: SERVICE_SECRETS={"host":"cache.prod","port":6379,"auth":"token123","rot":"3"}
```

jose: So staging ended up with a SOPS-wrapped YAML blob (multiline), prod has a compact JSON string. Our consumer parses line-by-line for YAML and the JSON one causes silent fallback to defaults. That explains the degraded cache hitrate in canary.

theo: Change window closes in 1h20m. If we hotpatch prod we'll need infra lead ok.

anika: Impact: if promoted, prod pods will see the JSON and skip TLS flags that only exist in YAML meta, resulting in soft failures (increased latency). Not safe.

jose: How did this happen? Migration script that normalizes secret backends had a missing serializer for sops->json when secret contained multiline YAML. Only tenant-scoped keys hit it.

ops-oncall: Options: 1) rollback to v2026.06.11 and backfill parity 2) add a short-lived compatibility toggle in config (SERVICE_SECRETS_FORMAT=auto) via rollout override to let the parser accept both formats 3) create a one-off backfill that converts prod secret to SOPS-wrapped YAML to match staging.

anika: Rollback would be safest, but it'll block a few other bugfixes already queued. Toggle sounds lower blast radius and faster. I can prepare a canary with the parser toggle in 25m.

sec-bot: Security note: toggles that widen parsing should be OK for a short window, but any backfill or toggle must not write secrets to logs. Audit trail required for any paramstore writes.

jose: If we do toggle, we should also create a compatibility alias SERVICE_SECRETS_RAW that points to the existing prod value so we don't mutate original key. That gives us a way to revert without rollbacks. I'll create the alias and emit audit event. ETA 15m.

ci-bot: Reminder: CI integration tests assert exact serialized strings. Update tests to accept SERVICE_SECRETS_RAW when present, else fall back.

anika: Spinning up 5% canary with SERVICE_SECRETS_FORMAT=auto and parser tolerant mode. No secret logging. Will run 12m smoke.

jose: Alias SERVICE_SECRETS_RAW created in paramstore and audit logged: https://audit.internal/entry/11577-raw-alias

anika: Canary smoke (12m) shows no parsing errors, cache metrics stable, no TLS regressions. :thumbsup:

theo: Infra eyeballs green. Ops approves limited rollout as long as we keep toggle and alias for <48h and backfill plan exists.

anika: I'll widen rollout to 30% and monitor for 30m. If stable, we'll mark release RESUMED and include note.

jose: Follow-up ticket created: SEC-1229 standardize SERVICE_SECRETS serializer across envs and remove compat toggle+alias.

ops-oncall: Approved for limited rollout. Keep rollback instructions ready. @anika @jose please post final PR and runbook snippet.

deploy-bot: Release v2026.06.12 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (parser-toggle) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assignments: anika (canary + config toggle), jose (alias + audit), theo (monitor), sec-bot (security sign-off). Action items logged.

ci-bot: preflight id=11577 updated: check failures resolved after alias + tolerant parser toggle. Tests updated to prefer SERVICE_SECRETS_RAW when present.

anika: Drafted release note: "Deployment paused due to service secret encoding mismatch between staging (SOPS-wrapped YAML) and prod (compact JSON). Temporary parser-toggle and SERVICE_SECRETS_RAW alias used for controlled rollout. Follow-up: migrate all envs to standard serialized JSON or SOPS YAML and remove compatibility artifacts." Confluence: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.06.12-secret-format-drift

deploy-bot: Final log entry saved: reason=env-parity-secret-serializer-drift; decision=tolerant-parser+alias; follow-up=SEC-1229.
